description: Use when the user asks what a Dutch neighbourhood or postcode area is like: residents and age mix, housing and home values, household income, energy use, distances to 18 amenities, police-registered crime vs national rate and liveability score, in English. Input: any postcode or CBS buurt code. Sources: CBS, Politie, Leefbaarometer. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.

code.description: Alternative: CBS neighbourhood code, e.g. BU05182245

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS

name: nl_neighbourhood
title: Dutch neighbourhood profile (paid)
